title: The problem with integer programming
abstract_summary: Surveys structural obstacles to integer programming and alternative mathematical representations.
method_summary: Uses integer monoids and nested-rounding Chvátal functions including directed-tree representations.
contribution_summary: Explicitly states shift periodicity and illustrates affine average gradient of a nested rounding tree.
overlap_with_roundguard: Direct prior art for affine drift plus periodic rounding residuals.
difference_or_limit: Does not give the proposed mixed-mode bounded-grid invoice analyzer. Working paper is 2010; journal issue is 2011; DOI imaman not inaman.

title: Discrete subadditive functions as Gomory functions
venue: Mathematical Proceedings of the Cambridge Philosophical Society
read_depth: Publisher extract and metadata; not full proof
abstract_summary: Studies when discrete subadditive functions belong to a class arising in pure integer programming.
method_summary: Uses pure integer programming proof methods motivated by discrete metrics.
contribution_summary: Characterizes a class of Gomory functions and connects it to discrete subadditivity.
overlap_with_roundguard: Older foundation referenced by Williams for Chvátal simplification and discrete functions.
difference_or_limit: Full proof not inspected; no specific periodicity theorem attributed to this paper. Print issue year 1995 despite later online digitization.

title: Mixed-Integer Linear Representability, Disjunctions, and Chvátal Functions—Modeling Implications
authors: Amitabh Basu; Kipp Martin; Christopher Thomas Ryan; Guanyi Wang
read_depth: Core Definition 2.2 and Section 3 elimination proofs
abstract_summary: Characterizes mixed-integer representable sets through affine Chvátal inequalities.
method_summary: Binary trees of rational affine leaves, positive scaling, addition, ceiling; sequential elimination with auxiliary integer variables.
contribution_summary: Gives exact algebraic representation and projection closure without requiring disjunctions.
overlap_with_roundguard: Strong syntactic overlap with affine rounding trees and exact Presburger encodings.
difference_or_limit: Positive scaling and ceiling fragment; does not state the specific invoice finite-state optimization.

title: isl: An Integer Set Library for the Polyhedral Model
read_depth: Publisher abstract; official manual Section 1.4.13 and set operations
abstract_summary: Presents a library for exact manipulation of integer sets and relations bounded by affine constraints.
method_summary: Arbitrary-precision integer arithmetic, integer-set operations, and quasi-affine expressions with constant integer division.
contribution_summary: Reusable infrastructure for exact polyhedral and Presburger-style analysis.
overlap_with_roundguard: Exact integer encoding of fixed-quantum rational affine rounding is within this framework.
difference_or_limit: General library; not a monetary-policy tool or a claim of minimal residue periods.

title: Presburger arithmetic, rational generating functions, and quasi-polynomials
abstract_summary: Connects Presburger-definable sets and counting functions to rational generating functions and piecewise quasi-polynomials.
method_summary: Logical and geometric characterizations of integer sets using linear inequalities and quantifiers.
contribution_summary: Provides equivalent representations and discusses their complexity.
overlap_with_roundguard: Establishes mature exact integer framework adjacent to rounding residue structure.
difference_or_limit: Counting theorem is not itself the proposed equality or discrepancy algorithm.

title: Catala: a programming language for the law
authors: Denis Merigoux; Nicolas Chataing; Jonathan Protzenko
venue: Proceedings of the ACM on Programming Languages
abstract_summary: Introduces an executable language for computational statutes with general-rule and exception structure.
method_summary: Default logic and a compiler whose core transformations are proved in F*.
contribution_summary: Evaluates US tax and French benefit encodings and reports an official implementation bug.
overlap_with_roundguard: Prior application of formal methods to taxes and benefits.
difference_or_limit: No specialized exact rounding-period or invoice discrepancy DP.

title: Formalizing Date Arithmetic and Statically Detecting Ambiguities for the Law
authors: Raphaël Monat; Aymeric Fromherz; Denis Merigoux
read_depth: Core semantics, paired analysis, sync definition, case study
abstract_summary: Formalizes ambiguous date arithmetic used in legal eligibility computations.
method_summary: F* semantic properties and relational abstract interpretation of paired rounding modes.
contribution_summary: Proves rounding-insensitivity in some cases and finds date ambiguities in housing benefits.
overlap_with_roundguard: Direct prior art for rounding-policy sensitivity verification in computational law.
difference_or_limit: Calendar arithmetic rather than rational monetary grids; abstract analysis need not yield exact global monetary extrema.

title: CUTECat: Concolic Execution for Computational Law
authors: Pierre Goutagny; Aymeric Fromherz; Raphaël Monat
read_depth: Core Sections 2-4; rounding and backend discrepancy passages
abstract_summary: Generates tests for computational law while handling default logic.
method_summary: Concrete plus SMT symbolic execution; exact rational values; sign-branch floor encoding of nearest ties-away rounding.
contribution_summary: Scales to Catala laws and reports a Python backend rounding inconsistency that was fixed upstream.
overlap_with_roundguard: Already performs exact monetary rounding reasoning and generates discrepant backend inputs.
difference_or_limit: No structural period reduction or exact maximum invoice discrepancy; broader language and branching support.

title: Daisy - Framework for Analysis and Optimization of Numerical Programs (Tool Paper)
authors: Eva Darulova; Anastasiia Izycheva; Fariha Nasir; Fabian Ritter; Heiko Becker; Robert Bastian
venue: Tools and Algorithms for the Construction and Analysis of Systems, TACAS 2018
read_depth: Core Section 3 fixed-point and optimization-based analysis
abstract_summary: Combines numerical accuracy analyses and optimizations in a single framework.
method_summary: Dataflow/affine/interval analysis, subdivision, and optimization approaches for floating and fixed point.
contribution_summary: Modular implementation covering error estimation and accuracy optimization.
overlap_with_roundguard: Established sound roundoff and fixed-point analysis; comparisons should acknowledge it.
difference_or_limit: Typically returns conservative error bounds against real semantics, not attainable monetary policy discrepancies.

title: Rigorous Estimation of Floating-Point Round-off Errors with Symbolic Taylor Expansions
authors: Alexey Solovyev; Charles Jacobsen; Zvonimir Rakamarić; Ganesh Gopalakrishnan
read_depth: Core Section 3 objective and abstract error model; proof certificate passages
abstract_summary: Computes rigorous maximum floating-point roundoff bounds including transcendental functions.
method_summary: Symbolic Taylor expansion of error variables plus rigorous global optimization and HOL Light certificates.
contribution_summary: Tighter sound bounds on many benchmarks and released reproducible tool.
overlap_with_roundguard: Worst-case numerical error analysis and certificates already exist.
difference_or_limit: Optimizes an abstraction, allowing overapproximation; not exact comparison of explicit fixed-quantum policies.

title: Static Analysis of Finite Precision Computations
venue: Verification, Model Checking, and Abstract Interpretation, VMCAI 2011
read_depth: Publisher abstract and author-hosted primary text
abstract_summary: Bounds program values and differences between real and finite-precision computations.
method_summary: Interval and affine-set/zonotopic abstract domains tracking error propagation and provenance.
contribution_summary: Implemented Fluctuat analyses for accuracy, sensitivity, and test generation.
overlap_with_roundguard: Established finite-precision discrepancy analysis and provenance.
difference_or_limit: Sound abstraction rather than guaranteed attainable optimum for monetary rounding-policy differences.

title: Synthesis of fixed-point programs
authors: Eva Darulova; Viktor Kuncak; Rupak Majumdar; Indranil Saha
venue: International Conference on Embedded Software, EMSOFT 2013
read_depth: Primary abstract, problem formulation, hardness, related work
abstract_summary: Finds fixed-point implementations of real polynomials with improved worst-case accuracy.
method_summary: Expression rewriting and genetic programming with affine-arithmetic error analysis.
contribution_summary: Shows NP-hardness for a synthesis decision problem and demonstrates improved controller expressions.
overlap_with_roundguard: Evaluation order and fixed-point worst-case errors are studied prior problems.
difference_or_limit: Synthesis of equivalent real expressions differs from exact verification between fixed prescribed monetary programs.

title: Combinatorics and Algorithms on Low-Discrepancy Roundings of a Real Sequence
authors: Kunihiko Sadakane; Nadia Takki-Chebihi; Takeshi Tokuyama
read_depth: Publisher abstract; accessible proceedings excerpt of Sections 3-4
abstract_summary: Represents sequences of integral roundings that satisfy subinterval discrepancy requirements.
method_summary: Compact state graphs and Viterbi-style dynamic optimization over feasible roundings.
contribution_summary: Enumerates global roundings and builds optimal compact representations for weaker discrepancy conditions.
overlap_with_roundguard: Finite-state dynamic programming for rounding discrepancy predates this project.
difference_or_limit: Chooses rounding outputs for a fixed input sequence; does not optimize input grids under prescribed monetary policies.

title: Interactive Proofs for Rounding Arithmetic
authors: Shuo Chen; Jung Hee Cheon; Dongwoo Kim; Daejun Park
read_depth: Primary full-text problem formulation and theorem overview
abstract_summary: Verifies outsourced approximate computations expressed as circuits with rounding gates.
method_summary: Generalizes GKR over a ring and reduces rounding to low-degree polynomial circuits.
contribution_summary: Efficient interactive proof machinery supporting approximate arithmetic.
overlap_with_roundguard: Formal verification and proof objects for rounding arithmetic are established.
difference_or_limit: Certifies evaluation of a circuit, not equivalence or attainable worst-case discrepancy over all monetary inputs.

title: Coding computational laws: 20 recommendations for public administrations
abstract_summary: Recommends practices for developing and maintaining long-lived legal computations.
method_summary: Synthesis of computational-law implementation experience and interdisciplinary recommendations.
contribution_summary: Addresses representation, legal interpretation, deterministic behavior, testing, maintenance, and longevity.
overlap_with_roundguard: Explicitly discusses arbitrary-precision monetary numbers and rounding risks.
difference_or_limit: Recommendations article; no finite-residue exact optimization theorem. Publisher notes a subsequent correction.

title: Faster 0-1-Knapsack via Near-Convex Min-Plus-Convolution
venue: 31st Annual European Symposium on Algorithms, ESA 2023
abstract_summary: Improves pseudopolynomial knapsack algorithms through structured min-plus convolution.
method_summary: Near-convex min-plus convolution and improved dependence on maximum item weight/profit.
contribution_summary: Faster exact knapsack algorithms in relevant parameter regimes.
overlap_with_roundguard: Convolution as a dynamic-programming primitive is established.
difference_or_limit: Near-convexity is a separate premise; cyclic rounding residue tables need not satisfy it.

title: Deterministic Monotone Min-Plus Product and Convolution
authors: Ce Jin; Jaewoo Park; Barna Saha; Yinzhan Xu
venue: 53rd International Colloquium on Automata, Languages, and Programming, ICALP 2026
read_depth: Primary abstract and knapsack application discussion
abstract_summary: Derandomizes structured min-plus product and convolution algorithms.
method_summary: Deterministic algorithms exploiting bounded monotone inputs with downstream knapsack applications.
contribution_summary: Nearly matches prior randomized structured convolution bounds.
overlap_with_roundguard: Current 2026 prior art confirms min/max-plus convolution is a mature primitive.
difference_or_limit: Requires monotonicity/structure absent from arbitrary residue-error tables; not a direct monetary verifier.

title: The Well-Rounded Total
venue: Author-hosted preliminary draft, not peer reviewed
read_depth: Primary abstract, problem statement, algorithm claims, disclosure of draft status
abstract_summary: Studies rounded financial reports whose totals must remain consistent.
method_summary: Algorithms for forest-structured totals and minimax rounding; general consistency hardness.
contribution_summary: Linear-time feasible rounding and O(n log n) minimax algorithm for forests.
overlap_with_roundguard: Direct adjacent financial-total rounding optimization prior art.
difference_or_limit: Chooses rounding values for a fixed financial report; not worst input discrepancy between prescribed policies; explicitly non-peer-reviewed.

title: Probabilistic Floating-Point Round-Off Analysis via Concentration Inequalities
authors: Yichen Tao; Hongfei Fu; Jiawei Chen; Jean-Baptiste Jeannin
venue: arXiv preprint; described as long version of OOPSLA 2026 paper
abstract_summary: Derives probabilistic roundoff thresholds for floating-point programs.
method_summary: Concentration inequalities over Taylor error expansions with polynomial overapproximation and range partitioning.
contribution_summary: Scalable probabilistic numerical error analysis under stated independence models.
overlap_with_roundguard: Current 2026 numerical-analysis neighbor checked for the search cutoff.
difference_or_limit: Probabilistic bounds rather than exact deterministic monetary policy extrema; final journal metadata not asserted.
